verdicts.reason: Both pull the 'EVENT MANAGEMENT' eyebrow to the far top-left corner, where it is tiny, hard to read and cut off from the headline it belongs to. Both also leave a left half of loose confetti with nothing anchoring it. A's owls are large enough to read as the key imagery and balance the big three-line headline, though the brown owl crowds 'KIDS' and the headline runs close to the right edge. In B the owls shrink to a cramped little pair, leaving more dead space and less charm.
